text: 🇲🇽🏭 "A vehicle designed by young Mexican minds, for Mexico and for the world." Mexico unveiled Olinia today — a 100% Mexican electric car developed over 18 months by young researchers from public institutions (IPN, Tecnológico Nacional de México). President Sheinbaum drove it onto the stage at Santa Lucía herself. "Es un vehículo diseñado por mentes de jóvenes mexicanos para México y para el mundo. No se trata solamente de fabricar un automóvil eléctrico. Se trata de demostrar que somos capaces de imaginarlo, diseñarlo, desarrollarlo y hacerlo realidad." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Base Militar de Santa Lucía, June 7 2026 Production begins in Puebla, 2027.

🇲🇽📉 <u>OCDE CUTS MEXICO GROWTH FORECAST TO 0.8% — TRUMP TARIFFS ARE THE STORY</u>

OCDE slashed Mexico's 2026 growth projection to 0.8% (down from 1.3%), explicitly citing "economic policy uncertainty, commercial tariffs, and fiscal consolidation" — in plain language, Trump's trade war. Q1 contracted 0.6% across industry, agriculture, and services. Domestic demand and low unemployment held the floor. 2027 was revised UP to 1.8%, signaling the shock is exogenous, not structural. As El Financiero's Enrique Quintana put it in his "Bajo Presión" column on June 4: the pressure has a return address — and it's 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.

🇲🇽💧 <u>MICHOACÁN RESERVOIRS RECOVER: 44.5% CAPACITY, NO WATER CRISIS</u>

Conagua delegate Roberto Arias confirmed Michoacán's 24 reservoirs and lakes average 44.5% capacity as the rainy season begins — Sabaneta is at 98.8%, José María Morelos at 95%, with favorable rainfall forecast through the rest of 2026. "In general terms there is no water crisis," he said. Lakes Pátzcuaro and Cuitzeo, devastated by historic drought losses in 2024-25, are showing real recovery. State capacity to monitor and manage — not privatized water — is what kept the lights on.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>NAKBA 77 YEARS, GAZA GENOCIDE 32 MONTHS — BDS IS NOT OPTIONAL</u>

Ruth Dávila Figueroa (CIDE) writes in Contralínea that 6 million Palestinian refugees remain registered with UNRWA — the cumulative result of 70+ years of "colonial and expansionist projects by the Israeli state and Zionism," now openly a genocide since October 7, 2023. She names the corporations profiting from occupation: Elbit Systems, Fanuc, HSBC. Her call: arms embargo, BDS, commercial and cultural isolation. Mexican universities, unions, and pension funds can move tomorrow. Silence at this point is complicity.

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>JUDICIAL REFORM 1 YEAR ON: DEMOCRATIZATION WORKED</u>

Circuit Court Judge Ana María Ibarra Olguín, writing in Contralínea on the anniversary of Mexico's historic June 2025 judicial elections, concludes the reform "emerged as a response to a growing distance between judges and citizens." The old system was "slow, expensive, and incomprehensible," she writes — and trust had collapsed across every social sector. The road ahead: deeper training in human rights and gender perspective, stronger local courts where most citizens actually meet the judiciary. Western press called popular election of judges the end of democracy. One year in, it's the start of it.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>CUBA RECEIVES 6TH MEXICAN AID SHIPMENT AS US BLOCKADE TIGHTENS</u>

Cargo ship Asian Katra entered Havana port Sunday morning with 1,700 tons of rice, beans, and powdered milk — the sixth humanitarian shipment Mexico has sent since February, bringing the total to over 3,125 tons of food, medicine, hygiene products, and solar panels. The Mexican ambassador confirmed the cargo "is intended to support the Cuban population." Sheinbaum reiterated Mexico will keep sending aid; on oil, "Cuba is receiving it from Russia." Four months into Washington's petroleum blockade, the empire's siege isn't working.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>SHEINBAUM DRIVES MEXICO'S FIRST DOMESTIC ELECTRIC VEHICLE</u>

President Sheinbaum drove the Olinia 1 prototype to Santa Lucía in Zumpango today — Mexico's first 100% nationally designed electric car, developed by researchers at IPN and TecNM. Starting price: 150,000 pesos. Six passengers. Charges from any household outlet. First plant targets 20,000 units a year, scaling to 50,000 within four years. "Olinia is part of Plan México," Sheinbaum said — accessible mobility built at home, not imported from Detroit or Shanghai.
